niche: a Dutch seat-licensed diagramming SaaS forecasting its December 2027 annual recurring revenue for the board's 2027 plan, with a list price rise still landing at annual renewals, a new seat minimum on its monthly plan, seat right-sizing at renewal that follows how many licensed users actually work in the product, a sales pipeline that ages, and subsidiaries that leave together when a parent group consolidates vendors
answer: commit EUR 9.9 million of December 2027 ARR (80 per cent figure EUR 9,890,000), not the draft's EUR 10.2 million
analyst_test: A careful but hurried analyst rebuilds the opening ARR correctly, then carries the book forward on trailing net revenue retention, recent monthly-plan churn and the CRM's stage probabilities with a band that treats accounts as independent, so the uplift is counted twice, padded monthly seats are run off too fast, the pipeline is credited at its stated odds and the 80 per cent figure sits above what the board can commit to.
domain_test: Every result is a recurring-revenue retention quantity the cohort and lifetime-value task type estimates (price realisation at renewal, seat retention by utilisation and renewal number, a duration-dependent hazard on a shocked monthly cohort, pipeline conversion by stage and age, an ARR path with a band); swap in hospital or utility nouns and the annual renewal calendar, seat licences against active users and the list-price repricing at renewal stop making sense.
layer1: contract lines re-exported twice by the nightly billing job (exact duplicate rows)
renewal lines issued at list price, credited and re-issued
onboarding fees and part-term true-up charges on the contract export
GBP contracts converted at the finance plan rate
Team invoices re-issued after a failed card payment
CRM opportunity amounts typed per month by some owners and per year by others
duplicate snapshot rows from a re-run export job
company and parent account names typed several ways in the CRM
stakeholder_role: the CFO, who puts the December 2027 ARR commitment in the board's 2027 plan

world.geography: the Netherlands (Utrecht) with customers across the EU and the UK
world.org_type: a seat-licensed online diagramming and whiteboard software company

driver: A forward total is the sum of several flows each set by its own mechanism (a step change still applying unit by unit at each unit's anniversary, a one-off shock whose excess exit rate decays with time since it hit, a size adjustment at each anniversary set by how much of its capacity each unit uses, a pipeline whose conversion falls with each item's age, and exits that arrive together within groups), so the trailing aggregate rate, the recent pooled rate, the stated conversion odds and an independent-unit band each misstate a different piece and the committed low quantile.
driver_concrete: December 2027 ARR is the October 2026 book plus the March 2026 price rise still to land at Business renewals from November to February at the realised (not list) uplift, less the Team accounts padded to the new three-seat minimum running off on a hazard that falls with months since padding, less the seats Business accounts shed at renewal where utilisation is low (first renewals most), less logo churn that clusters by parent group, plus new Business ARR from a pipeline whose win rate falls with deal age, with the 80 per cent commitment read from a simulation that keeps a parent's accounts together.
stump: A careful but hurried analyst rebuilds the October 2026 ARR correctly, then applies the mean realised uplift to every contract still to reprice, pools renewal exit and seat-cut rates without utilisation, first renewals or group exits, carries the Team plan's last three months' exit rates, values the open pipeline at the CRM's stage probabilities and draws accounts independently for the band, and files EUR 10.2 million as the 80 per cent figure, clearing the draft, when large contracts negotiate the rise down, seat cuts follow utilisation, the April exits are fading, old open deals rarely close and parent groups leave together, so the figure is EUR 9.9 million.
results: R1 opening ARR at 31 Oct 2026 by plan; R2 price uplift still to land at Business renewals; R3 the October Team book's ARR left in December 2027; R4 Business ARR lost to seat cuts and to non-renewal at 2027 renewals; R5 new Business ARR signed by December 2027; R6 the December 2027 ARR, its 80 per cent band and the figure with an 80 per cent chance of being met; R7 the monthly path and a bridge that adds back
one_fact_test: old open deals rarely close, so the CRM's stage odds overstate the pipeline; executed on the careful pass it rescues R5 and R6 (2 of 7, effort.json)

differentiation.mark162: mark162's spent v1 had units taking a new version only at their next restart, a timing of one uptake; here a price step lands at each contract's anniversary as one of five flows (a decaying shock hazard, utilisation-driven seat change at renewal, age-decaying pipeline conversion and group-clustered exits), and no single flow carries the answer

lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-09: the project lead's review returned the single-deep-step design (one constructed factor, the tutors' stopping hump, placed in the forward cohort by an onboarding pause and surge; every graded figure came out of one projection)
lineage.driver: A unit's chance of reaching a milestone is set largely by whether the provider it is attached to keeps operating, providers stop at a rate that peaks a few months into their own tenure, and the forward group was attached almost wholly to providers in their first months, so an exit curve by the unit's own tenure, which validates on closed groups, overstates how many reach the milestone.
lineage.stump: A competent solver projects the autumn campaign's members on the platform's paid-retention curve by membership month, validated on the spring 2025 campaign and last autumn's joiners, and files about EUR 725 per twelfth-month member, inside the EUR 800 bar, and books the re-run; the step that lands it there is projecting each member on their own tenure when the member's cancellation rides on their tutor, and the autumn members' tutors are about to cross the months in which new tutors stop teaching.

notes: re-root of v1 (tutor-linked member retention, returned in kind by the 2026-11-09 review as one hidden constructed factor)
